content.text: {"name":"V06_yoy_spread_V04","hypothesis":"Groups whose V06 stock rate has risen more over 12 months relative to their V04 flow rate, compared cross-sectionally, have lower next-month returns, so the cross-sectional rank correlation with future returns is negative.","falsified_if":"Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or positive, or the absolute HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.","expression":"spread(yoy(V06),mavg(V04,6))"}
